title: Charleston's ONLY True Crimes Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for physically disabled persons
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You’ll retrace the final movements of a man who ended up at the bottom of a well—an ax buried in his skull and a question that still cuts sharp: who put him there? You’ll stand where passion turned predatory, where a hurried shovel of dirt tried to bury the truth in a shallow grave. And you’ll reopen a midcentury murder so strange it sounds ripped from a game of Clue—until the documents prove it happened here, in this very city.

At every stop, your guide lays out the facts like exhibits—what the record confirms, what it contradicts, and what it leaves chillingly unresolved. No invented shadows. No tidy endings. Just real names, real places, and consequences that still echo in the brickwork of the very houses where it happened.
